sources.snippet: Abstract: Recently, language model (LM) based text-to-speech (TTS) emerges into the mainstream due to their high naturalness and zero-shot capacity. In this paradigm, speech signals are discretized into token sequences, which are modeled by an LM with textual inputs and reconstructed by a token-based vocoder to waveforms.
